experiments.name: Annotation Validation
experiments.goal: Validate that graph annotation protocol produces consistent results
inputs: 200 jailbreak prompts annotated by 2-3 independent annotators

experiments.name: Graph vs Text Detection
experiments.goal: Test whether graph features complement text features for jailbreak detection

experiments.name: Transferability Prediction
experiments.goal: Predict whether a jailbreak that works on one model also works on another

experiments.name: Motif Discovery
experiments.goal: Find recurring subgraph patterns and their association with jailbreak success
experiments.method: Enumerate directed subgraphs of size 2-4 and rank by frequency and success rate

experiments.name: Fairness / Overblocking
experiments.goal: Measure per-subgroup false-positive rates and disparity

experiments.name: Multi-Turn vs Single-Turn
experiments.goal: Compare attack success rates for single-turn and multi-turn attacks
